productId.title: Product ID
productId.description: Canonical stable UUID key for cross-app references. Defaults to and equals the OpenRegister object UUID. shillinq stock-keeping and the integration registry use this as the FK — never change it after first write.

gtin.title: GTIN
gtin.description: Global Trade Item Number (GS1). Supply-side master attribute, distinct from the POS barcode scan field. Format: GTIN-8, GTIN-12 (UPC), GTIN-13 (EAN), or GTIN-14.

manufacturer.title: Manufacturer
manufacturer.description: Maker or brand owner of this product (schema:manufacturer). Authoritative supply-side attribute.

unitOfMeasure.title: Unit of measure
unitOfMeasure.description: Canonical unit for stock-keeping (e.g. each, kg, litre, box, m2). shillinq lot/batch valuation and FIFO/AVG calculations key off this field.

weight.title: Weight (kg)
weight.description: Gross weight per unit of measure, in kilograms. Used for logistics and freight cost estimation.

dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.description: Physical dimensions per unit. Used for warehousing slot allocation and freight calculations.

hazardClass.title: Hazard class
hazardClass.description: ADR/UN dangerous-goods classification code (e.g. '3', '8', '9'). Required for hazardous-goods warehousing compliance.

stockTracked.title: Stock tracked
stockTracked.description: Whether shillinq should maintain stock records for this product. Set false for services and downloadable goods that need no physical inventory.

vendor.title: Vendor
vendor.description: The vendor/supplier this product is procured from. Cross-app reference resolved by the canonical role type https://openregister.app/ns#Vendor (ADR-048) — sourced from shillinq's Payee (accounts-payable vendor) master when installed; otherwise the field is unfillable, since the supplying app is optional. Uses the precise ns#Vendor role rather than the broad schema.org/Organization so it targets the AP vendor, not any organisation.

consumableBy.title: Consumable by
consumableBy.description: App slugs permitted to read this product's master data through the integration registry. Default ["shillinq"]. The registry provider enforces this list.
